description.text: Program Introduction: This major requires students to understand and familiarity with the basic theories and basic knowledge of international economic trade and international finance on the basis of systematic study and mastery of English professional skills and English professional knowledge. They are required to receive basic training in economics and management, with modern management awareness and strategic vision. The real English language foundation is related to the theoretical analysis and practical skills of related disciplines. Through the study and training of this major, it has good political and ideological quality, and can directly use English to engage in international trade's foreign ability and adaptability, understand the necessary economic theory, and be familiar with the export-oriented and compound talents of international business application norms and procedures. Future Career: Foreign investment and Sino foreign joint ventures, foreign trade enterprises, financial institutions and scientific research and teaching units, government institutions and foreign consulates and cultural institutions in China are engaged in international trade, translation, management, consultation and teaching, and can also go abroad for further study and study for master's graduate students. Duration: 4years Fees Tuition Fee: 26,000 CNY/Yr. Accommodation: Two room apartment with a bathroom and kitchen: 1,300 CNT/Mth. per room Shared bed-room with a bathroom: 550 CNY/Mth.per bed Single room with bathroom: 1,100 CNY/Mth. per room * Electric and water costs are not included.

duration.text: The International Trade at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants should have the equivalent of a high school education 2.Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school 3.Applicants should be under thirty five years old in general 4.Applicants should have good command of English and the ability to take courses in English; Applicants are required to submit the certificates of 90 or more in TOEFL, 5.5 or more in IELTS or any other proofs about English level. All the applicants should pass the English Level Test at the beginning of the first semester in BUAA
